diagnostics.message: The explicit depends_on from :resource.local_file.public_ssh_key to :resource.tls_private_key.ssh duplicates the dependency already created by the content reference to the private key resource.
The explicit depends_on from :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key to :resource.tls_private_key.ssh duplicates the dependency already created by the content reference to the private key resource.

The runner Auto Scaling group can launch instances as soon as its launch configuration exists, but the instance role's docker-machine permissions may still be attaching. Make the group wait for this attachment so the runner agent has the permissions it needs at startup.

The runner Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the instance role's cache policy attachment is complete, leaving newly started runners without the configured cache access. Make the group wait for this attachment.

The runner Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the optional service-linked-role permission is attached. When enabled, the runner may need this permission for docker-machine operations during startup; make the group wait for the attachment.

The runner's user-data startup may access SSM before the runner-token permission is attached to its instance role. Make the Auto Scaling group wait for the SSM policy attachment so startup does not race IAM policy propagation.
With CloudWatch logging enabled, instances launched by the Auto Scaling group can start logging before the instance role's inline logging policy is in place. Make the group wait for this role policy.

The launch configuration's user data configures CloudWatch logging for the environment, but the Auto Scaling group does not wait for the corresponding log group to exist. This can make initial log delivery fail or race group creation.
